title: Core 008 Postmortem — Functional Capacity Decomposition
purpose: Determine whether Core 008 failed because real write demands lack compressible shared structure, because the rank/sparsity budget was too restrictive, or because the online certified allocator failed to discover structure that exists offline.

data_identity.reason_reuse_is_diagnostic_only: The seeds and outcomes are already observed. This bridge may diagnose them but cannot emit a new confirmatory supported/not-supported decision.

write_geometry.write_demand: G = mean_t[(U^T dL/dh_t) z_t^T] on the frozen foundation path

diagnostics.per_write_svd: For each train/eval write independently, compute the optimal rank-r truncated-SVD residual. This measures intrinsic rank without any shared-basis assumption.
diagnostics.global_pca: Fit an unconstrained PCA/SVD basis to flattened normalized train writes and evaluate heldout residual at dimensions 1..32. This is a geometric shared-subspace upper bound and is not parameter-budget matched.
diagnostics.pca_sparse: Within the frozen 32-dimensional PCA basis, retain the largest k coefficients for k in 1,2,4,8,16,32. This isolates the cost of sparsity after the best dense linear subspace is known.
diagnostics.factorized_offline_dictionary: Under exactly 32 total rank units (4096 conceptual factor scalars at d=64), greedily fit shared rank-r matrix atoms for r in 1,2,4,8 with atom counts 32/r; recode by signed OMP with up to min(8, atom_count) active atoms. This is an offline no-certificate upper-bound diagnostic, not a deployable learner.
diagnostics.core008_reference: Report the published Core 008 adaptive oracle/deploy residuals beside the capacity curves but do not alter the frozen Core 008 decision.

classifications.PER_WRITE_LOW_RANK_BUT_NOT_SHARED: median per-write rank-16 local-action residual <= 0.35 but heldout PCA-32 residual > 0.35
classifications.BUDGET_MATCHED_FACTORIZED_STRUCTURE_PRES: at least one 32-rank-unit offline factorized dictionary has heldout median local-action residual <= 0.35
classifications.NO_STRONG_COMPRESSION_EVIDENCE: neither per-write rank-16 nor PCA-32 reaches the 0.35 reference

interpretation_boundary: This is a postmortem diagnostic on already-observed Core 008 seeds and cannot overturn, rescue, or replace the Core 008 scientific decision.
Good unconstrained PCA performance is evidence of shared linear geometry, not evidence that a practical Cell representation fits the same parameter budget.
Good per-write SVD with poor global PCA means writes are individually low-rank but do not share a small global basis.
Good factorized offline performance with poor Core 008 online performance localizes failure to online atom formation, sparsity, routing, certificate interaction, or allocation policy.
Poor performance even for per-write SVD/PCA upper bounds is evidence against further elaborating the current normalized G-matrix basis hypothesis.
